address.description: Individual's current address - PO boxes, UPS drops, and FedEx drops are not acceptable; APO/FPO are acceptable. Only USA addresses are currently supported.

dob.description: Individual's date of birth, as an RFC 3339 date.

email.description:
Individual's email address.
If utilizing Lithic for chargeback processing, this customer email address may be used to communicate dispute status and resolution.

first_name.description: Individual's first name, as it appears on government-issued identity documents.

government_id.description: Government-issued identification number (required for identity verification and compliance with banking regulations). Social Security Numbers (SSN) and Individual Taxpayer Identification Numbers (ITIN) are currently supported, entered as full nine-digits, with or without hyphens

last_name.description: Individual's last name, as it appears on government-issued identity documents.

phone_number.description: Individual's phone number, entered in E.164 format.
